name: California Berry Cultivars, LLC
description: Independent strawberry breeding company founded by Douglas Shaw, a former University of California, Davis strawberry breeder. Sued by Driscoll's for patent infringement over claims that Driscoll's proprietary strawberry germplasm was used in CBC's own breeding program; CBC won summary judgment in the district court in 2025 and Driscoll's has since appealed.

attributes.founder_background: Former University of California, Davis strawberry breeder
attributes.litigation_note: Won summary judgment against Driscoll's patent-infringement suit in district court (2025); Driscoll's has appealed. Multiple independent outlets (Fruitnet, Courthouse News, The Packer, Hort News, AndNowUKnow) have covered separate stages of this dispute.
